title: Nashville Building Permits (Enriched) output
description: One dataset row per permit (search mode) or per ranked contractor (contractors mode). Field reference is in the README.

results.title: Results as JSON
results.description: Every row from the run: normalized permits with the optional `enrichment` block, or ranked contractor rows.

resultsCsv.title: Results as CSV
resultsCsv.description: The same rows as a flat CSV. Nested enrichment fields are flattened with dot-separated column names.
